title: Tower Toppler (Nebulus) · NFI US release
notes: The supplied VERSION.NFO identifies Tower Toppler, the US release supplied as Nebulus, with joystick port 2 and two trainers.
The BASIC line's SYS2088 prefix is reviewed explicitly: its link points at the terminator and credits follow the decimal address.
PAL is the initial timing profile; the supplied PAL+NTSC metadata is not evidence of NTSC verification.
Startup sends Space and joystick fire to leave the release screens. Trainer keys are not pressed; trainer implementation and defaults remain unverified.
KERNAL LOAD reads TOWER1 from pinned disk bytes; serial-drive execution and transfer timing are not reproduced.
This recipe captures the original menu input loop. The first-tower browser scenario continues from that checkpoint and verifies gameplay coverage separately.
